news.headline: Nektar Reports Durable Rezpegaldesleukin Data In Alopecia Areata And Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: At EADV 2026, 75% of alopecia areata patients kept a SALT score <=20 four months off treatment and 63% at six months. Atopic dermatitis responses deepened through 52 weeks with monthly and quarterly maintenance dosing.

news.headline: Nektar presents early biomarker data for eczema drug at EADV 2026
news.summary: At EADV 2026 in Vienna, Nektar showed multi-omic biomarker data from the Phase 2b atopic dermatitis study: molecular changes as early as Week 2 tracked with clinical response at Week 16. The findings support the planned Phase 3 ZENITH AD program.

news.headline: Two funds hold 9.8% of Nektar Therapeutics (NKTR), with three parties reporting the same stake.
news.summary: Filings show two funds and three reporting parties disclosing the same 9.8% stake in Nektar.

news.headline: Nektar awarded $90 million in Lilly rezpeg dispute
news.summary: A California federal jury found Eli Lilly breached the implied covenant of good faith in the rezpegaldesleukin license and awarded Nektar $90M, far below the $1B sought. Post-trial motions and appeals remain possible.

news.headline: Nektar Announces Three Oral Presentations for Rezpegaldesleukin at the European Academy of Dermatology & Venereology (EADV) Congress 2026
news.summary: Nektar will present Phase 2b rezpegaldesleukin data in atopic dermatitis and alopecia areata in three oral sessions at EADV 2026, with an investor webcast on October 1.

news.headline: A Jury Awarded Nektar $90 Million From Eli Lilly. Here’s Why the Stock Barely Moved
news.summary: Coverage of the $90M jury award against Lilly and the share-price reaction, which was positive despite the sum being a fraction of the damages sought.

news.headline: Nektar Shares Extend Gains as BTIG Reiterates Buy, $178 Price Target After Lilly Verdict
news.summary: Nektar shares rose a further 5.4% on Sept 26 to around $60.75 as BTIG Research reaffirmed its Buy rating and $178 price target, extending the rally sparked by the Eli Lilly jury verdict two days earlier.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics awarded $90M jury verdict against Eli Lilly over rezpegaldesleukin dispute
news.summary: A California federal jury found Eli Lilly breached the implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing in its Rezpeg co-development deal with Nektar, awarding Nektar $90 million, well short of the roughly $1 billion sought.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Added to S&P Biotechnology Select Industry Index
news.summary: Nektar was added to the S&P Biotechnology Select Industry Index and removed from the S&P Pharmaceuticals Select Industry Index on September 11, 2026, a reclassification that reflects its shift toward a focused, pre-commercial biotech pipeline profile and can drive index-linked fund flows.

catalysts.label: Post-trial motions / appeal in Nektar v. Eli Lilly
catalysts.detail: A jury awarded Nektar $90M on Sept 24, 2026 for Lilly's breach of the implied covenant of good faith (well below the $1B sought), sending shares up ~15%; the court still must set interest, and the verdict is subject to post-trial motions and possible appeal by either side.

catalysts.label: EADV 2026 oral presentations and investor webcast
catalysts.detail: Three oral presentations of rezpegaldesleukin Phase 2b data (atopic dermatitis, alopecia areata) at EADV, followed by an investor webcast on October 1.

catalysts.label: REZOLVE-AA 24-week off-treatment durability data
catalysts.detail: Six-month off-treatment durability data were presented at EADV 2026 on Oct 1 (63% maintaining SALT <=20); this clears the gate for the Phase 3 start.

catalysts.label: Start of registrational Phase 3 alopecia areata study
catalysts.detail: Company is preparing the ~850-patient ZENITH AA Phase 3, targeted to start in early 2027, following the durability readout.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 trial initiation
catalysts.detail: Third global Phase 3 ZENITH AD study (treatment-experienced atopic dermatitis patients) guided to start in September 2026, following ZENITH AD-1/AD-2 initiation in July 2026.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD Phase 3 topline data
catalysts.detail: Initial topline data from the Phase 3 registrational atopic dermatitis program, ahead of a targeted 2029 BLA submission.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly earnings update on cash runway (>$1B as of June 30, 2026) and pipeline progress.

pulse: Nektar's biggest near-term overhang lifted on Sept 24, 2026 when a jury awarded the company $90M against Eli Lilly for breaching their Rezpeg co-development deal (short of the $1B sought, still subject to post-trial motions/appeal). Shares have kept climbing since, up roughly 15% the day after the verdict and a further 5.4% on Sept 26 as BTIG reiterated its Buy rating and $178 price target, even as Wedbush had cut its own target to $50 on safety/discontinuation concerns just before the ruling. The stock was also reclassified into the S&P Biotechnology Select Industry Index (out of the Pharmaceuticals index) on Sept 11, underscoring its repositioning as a pure-play pipeline biotech. On Sept 30 Nektar also presented early biomarker data for rezpegaldesleukin in atopic dermatitis at EADV 2026 (Vienna, through Oct 3), with the 6-month off-treatment REZOLVE-AA data also on the EADV program. On Oct 1 Nektar reported REZOLVE-AA durability data at EADV (63% of patients still responding six months off treatment) plus 52-week atopic dermatitis data. Attention now shifts to the planned Phase 3 ZENITH AA start in early 2027 and to the ramping ZENITH AD Phase 3 atopic dermatitis program (AD-1/AD-2 started July 2026, AD-3 guided for September). The company remains well-capitalized (~$1B cash as of mid-2026) but continues to face pipeline execution risk on both the alopecia and dermatitis fronts as it heads toward its next quarterly update.
